html.p: Added by SMIM curation: periplasmic DHA, completing the extracellular-periplasm-cytosol uptake chain (previously only M_dha_c existed, so H. walsbyi had DhaK/DhaL phosphorylation (R_DHAPT) but no stoichiometric route for DHA to enter the cell from the shared medium).
Added by SMIM curation: extracellular DHA, enabling R_EX_dha_e and GSMM-traceable cross-feeding from S. ruber.
